get.description: Lists all app spaces in the workspace.
Retrieves information for the app space with the supplied name.

patch.description: Updates an app space. The update process is asynchronous and the status of the update can be checked with the GetSpaceOperation method.

get.description: Gets the status of an app space update operation.
Lists all apps in the workspace.
Lists all custom templates in the workspace.

delete.description: Deletes the custom template with the specified name.

get.description: Gets the custom template with the specified name.

put.description: Updates the custom template with the specified name. Note that the template name cannot be updated.

get.description: Lists all app deployments for the app with the supplied name.

post.description: Creates an app deployment for the app with the supplied name.

get.description: Retrieves information for the app deployment with the supplied name and deployment id.
Gets the status of an app update.

post.description: Creates an app update and starts the update process. The update process is asynchronous and the status of the update can be checked with the GetAppUpdate method.

get.description: Retrieves information for the app with the supplied name.

patch.description: Updates the app with the supplied name.

post.description: Start the last active deployment of the app in the workspace.
Stops the active deployment of the app in the workspace.

delete.description: Deletes the thumbnail for an app.

patch.description: Updates the thumbnail for an app.
